data.gender_notes: Harnish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Harnish is derived from the Sanskrit word 'har' which means 'shining' or 'illuminating'. In Hindu mythology, Harnish is a name associated with the deity Lord Vishnu, who is known for his power to protect and preserve the universe. The name is believed to bring prosperity, wisdom, and a radiant aura. The name Harnish carries the meaning “Shining or illuminating” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Harnish usually hope their child will grow to embody shining or illuminating and live with faith, good character and purpose.
